_README: Recorded model outputs, replayed when no API key is present so that `npm start` works for anyone. In `npm run live` these same steps are produced by Meta's models in real time instead.

creative.prompt: Advertising photograph of a men's brown leather shoe on warm stone, late afternoon light, shallow depth of field. Leave the top third of the frame visually empty and evenly lit, so a headline can be composited there afterwards. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the image.
